files.reason: The new immediate internal catering checkbox is documented in the event guide. Existing carte groups, visibility, channel publication and draft publication procedures retain their prior behavior; the internal classification does not publish a carte.

These shared order/catalog contracts add the opt-in event context, internal carte provenance or its staff badge. The scoped existing configuration, permission, delivery, variant/photo and non-event workflows retain their procedures. New event and production behavior is covered in the five updated FR/HE/EN order guides.
